guidebook.intro: Say what work you do. Words for people who do a job start with **la-**, and their plural with **lu-**.

tips.title: La- does it
body: **La-** plus an action makes the person who does it: **pur** (dig) gives **lapur** (farmer), **pwony** (teach) gives **lapwony** (teacher), **ted** (cook) gives **latedo** (cook). The plural changes **la-** to **lu-**: **lupur**, **lupwony**.

tips.title: Itiyo tic ango?
body: **Itiyo tic ango?** (you work what work?) asks someone’s job. Answer with **An** and the job: **An lapur** (I am a farmer).

culture.title: Farming first
body: Most families farm, even when someone also works in town. **Apwoyo tic** is said to anyone working, whatever the job.
